text:
Carmen V: @channel Heads-up: previewing MI300e dedicated burst pools with new burst-throttling semantics. Regions: ca-central-1 (zones a/b) and eu-central-1 (zone c). Preview rollout next Tuesday.
Ibrahim R: quick context? why new burst semantics?
Carmen V: Ibrahim R: were introducing a soft-burst layer to support short spikes (e.g., large-batch offline evals) without impacting reserved latency SLOs. Its a different tradeoff than full preemptible pools.
SRE-Oncall: how does soft-burst behave vs preemptible?
Carmen V: Soft-burst = ephemeral extra capacity that can be throttled (not preempted) when reserved baseline is under pressure. Its rate-limited per-customer and per-AZ; will not evict running reserved jobs.
EngInfra: Ops mechanics: label = "gpu=mi300e-burst". Default per-customer burst cap = 10% of regional reserved baseline; global burst controller enforces backpressure.
Support: customer-facing wording?
Nadia F: Draft: "MI300e Burst Preview: short-lived extra capacity for batch/large-eval jobs. Not guaranteed; will be throttled under high reserved load. Ideal if you can tolerate variable throughput." Will share full copy.
Billing: pricing note: burst price = reserved_price * 0.5 during preview; will appear as line-item `mi300e_burst_credit` when auto-applied. Customers with committed credits will get prorated mapping.
Ibrahim R: Any compatibility concerns (drivers/kernels)?
EngInfra: MI300e burst uses same drivers as MI300e reserved; however container images must include ROCm 6.5+ for new kernels. We'll publish AMIs and container tags.
SRE-Oncall: Alerts & telemetry?
Carmen V: Alerts: `dedicated.mi300e.burst.throttle` (fires when throttle >15% for 10m), `dedicated.mi300e.burst.error_rate` (if job init failures spike), `dedicated.mi300e.burst.capacity_exhausted` (when regional burst pool depleted). OpsBot will post live summaries during preview windows.
OpsBot: [automated] Created preview reminders: 7d, 2d, 1d. Hourly burst summaries enabled for preview.
Ibrahim R: How do ops/engineers list active burst allocations?
EngInfra: helper:
```
redwoodctl allocations list --filter "gpu=mi300e-burst" --fields allocation_id,customer_id,requested_gpus,duration
```
Nadia F: Are we auto-migrating eligible jobs from other instance classes?
Carmen V: No auto-migration on day 0. We will offer an opt-in auto-burst toggle for jobs that are compatible. Manual migration guidance included in the doc.
Billing: Note: burst credit will not count toward Reserved commit fulfillment; will be billed separately. Finance okayed the preview pricing.
SRE-Oncall: Schedule staging canary for Monday 14:00 UTC. We'll validate throttle behavior and alert thresholds.
EngInfra: We'll push AMIs, ROCm matrix, and a validation checklist by EOD Friday.
Carmen V: Action items: (1) EngInfra publish images + helper scripts (2 business days). (2) SRE finalize alerts & dashboard (EOD Mon). (3) Billing publish preview pricing & reconciliation docs (EOD Mon). (4) Support prepare FAQ + console banner (preview start).
Ibrahim R: One more ask  can we surface burst cost estimate in Console before customers enable auto-burst?
Billing: Yes, we'll add an estimation widget showing expected delta based on recent job history. ETA: preview GA.
Carmen V: Thanks team. Link to internal plan + migration checklist: <https://go.redwood.ai/internal/dedicated/mi300e-burst-preview>. Please tag any workloads that must not be throttled with label `burst-sensitive` so we can exempt them from burst candidate pools.
